audit_scope: Read-only checks of exported artifacts; no database connection or new profiling.

order_diagnostics.interpretation: File order is observed; timestamps/randomized block identifiers are absent. Order diagnostics do not establish causation.

profile_yaml:
# Small REAL measurement protocol for a first executable check, not the paper's original protocol.
dsn_env: YMAP_POSTGRES_DSN
fixture_mode: deterministic_generated
rows_per_class: 100
repetitions: 5
warmup: 1
seed: 42
batch_size: 1000
query_limit: 100
statement_timeout_ms: 30000

workload.queries: one point lookup and one ordered limited scan per logical class; one ordered limited join per association
workload.link_policy: optional target skips every fifth object; many-to-many two sources per target
workload.cache_policy: no forced cache eviction; repeated freshly loaded data; ANALYZE before queries
workload.measurement_boundaries:
Measure actual PostgreSQL operations in fresh UUID-named schemas.

insert_ms: transaction wall time for the full logical fixture, including
client batching, network, indexes, constraints, and COMMIT; excludes DDL,
fixture creation, TRUNCATE, ANALYZE, and candidate generation.
query_ms: mean wall time per logical SQL query, including result fetch,
measured against the freshly loaded/analyzed warm-cache fixture.
storage_mb: sum pg_total_relation_size of candidate base tables, including
their indexes/TOAST, divided by 1,000,000 (decimal MB). Raw bytes retained.
Summary rows are medians across measured repetitions. Raw times retained.

environment.postgresql_version: PostgreSQL 14.24 (Debian 14.24-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
environment.environment_notes: Server hardware/storage/concurrent load are not automatically characterized.

evidence_limits: Exported records and oracle files agree; live database execution and timer implementation were not independently verified.
One seed, one fixed workload ID, one environment ID, 100 objects per declared concrete class; this is a new finite executable pilot.
Only 7 to 33 fixed logical queries per candidate: point lookups, ordered limited scans, and association joins; no aggregate-query family.
All scans/joins return 100 rows under LIMIT 100; oracle agreement does not prove full-content equivalence or mutation correctness.
No retained live per-table PostgreSQL row-count snapshot, full fetched result sets, server hardware/load characterization, or run timestamps.
Hospital/ERP fixture models have 11/12 logical classes, not the original manuscript's 35/42-class subjects.
Query timing includes client/network/result fetching; insert timing is for the complete logical-fixture transaction.
Per-repeat frontier comparisons are sensitivity diagnostics, not an alternative ground truth or an independent replication.
recommendation: Diagnose representation/label relationships and timing stability before rerunning all profiling. Preserve all observations. Use a targeted controlled randomized/interleaved rerun to assess timing reliability; design any larger journal experiment after diagnosis.
